description: This file contains unit tests for the EmailSubscriberAPI class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It defines a test class EmailSubscriberAPITest with multiple test methods that verify different API endpoints related to email subscription management, such as getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete. The class uses data providers to supply test cases and relies on mocking services and fixtures to isolate and test API logic.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the EmailSubscriberAPI through various test cases. It uses data providers for multiple test scenarios covering CRUD operations on email subscription resources.
